plan.notes: Hand-transcribed 2026-10-02 from the official Case Western Reserve University General Bulletin (2026-27) Marketing, BSM 'Sample Plan of Study' grid (https://bulletin.case.edu/management/programs/marketing-bsm/marketing-bsm.pdf). The bulletin advises majors to take ACCT 100, ECON 102 and MGMT 201 as early as possible, complete MKMR 201 by the end of the second year, and recommends MGMT 198, MGMT 205 and ACCT 106. Footnotes quoted from the bulletin: (a) Unified General Education Requirement; (b) 'Not required for the major or degree but recommended as elective course options.'; (c) 'Students must complete three 1 credit hour MGMT 395 offerings each of a different topic.' REPEATED COURSE: the official plan places MGMT 395 Seminar (1 cr) in Year 3 Fall, Year 3 Spring, and Year 4 Fall, matching the 'taken three times' requirement; allow_repeated_courses is set for this reason. 'Core Requirement' and 'Major Requirement' slots are choice placeholders for student-selected courses; unlabeled slots are elective placeholders. Footnote-b rows are elective choice placeholders naming the recommended option(s). Prerequisites are not printed in the sample plan, so prereq arrays are empty; prerequisites live in the bulletin's course descriptions.
